parts.text:
The query below will generate a report to categorise disaster areas according to the classification framework and rank disaster areas by their category and their Community Engagement Effectiveness scores. It will show each area's beneficiary registry ID, disaster reference, CEE score, and classification. Within each community status category, it will rank them.

```sql
SELECT
ba.beneregistry AS "Beneficiary Registry ID",
ba.benedistref AS "Disaster Reference",
ba.commengagelvl AS "CEE Score",
de.impactmetrics->>'classification' AS "Classification",
RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ba.commengagelvl ORDER BY (CASE ba.commengagelvl WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 END) DESC) AS "Rank"
FROM
beneficiariesandassessments AS ba
JOIN
disasterevents AS de ON ba.benedistref = de.distregistry;
```
